findings.evidence: `grep -rn "previousRestricted_zero|previousRestricted_succ|mem_previousRestricted_iff" TauCeti/` shows the two generic lemmas `previousRestricted_zero`/`previousRestricted_succ` have no consumer anywhere in the repo, while the Clifford copies carry all six uses — two parallel names for one fact.
findings.fix: Delete the three Clifford lemmas and use the generic names at their call sites: `PBW.lean:56` (`filtrationPreviousRestricted_zero` → `previousRestricted_zero (ι Q)`), `ExteriorFiltration.lean:96,111` (`filtrationPreviousRestricted_succ` → `previousRestricted_succ (ι Q)`), `FiltrationGradedEquiv.lean:93,94,172` (`mem_filtrationPreviousRestricted_iff` → `mem_previousRestricted_iff`).
findings.issue: `mem_filtrationPreviousRestricted_iff` (:166), `filtrationPreviousRestricted_zero` (:177) and `filtrationPreviousRestricted_succ` (:188) now restate the generic `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.mem_previousRestricted_iff` / `previousRestricted_zero` / `previousRestricted_succ` added at `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration/AssociatedGraded.lean:87,94,101`; since `filtration`/`filtrationPrevious`/`filtrationPreviousRestricted` are `abbrev`s, the statements and proofs are identical (`Iff.rfl`, `ext; simp`, the same `simp only [..., Submodule.submoduleOf, ...]`).

findings.evidence: `abbrev FiltrationGradedPiece Q k := filtration Q k ⧸ filtrationPreviousRestricted Q k` vs `abbrev GradedPiece f k := wordFiltration f k ⧸ previousRestricted f k`; with `filtration` reducible these are the same type, which is precisely why `gradedMul (ι Q)` typechecks against `FiltrationGradedPiece Q` in PBW.lean:155.
findings.fix: Delete both Clifford aliases and write `GradedPiece (ι Q) k` / `previousRestricted (ι Q) k` at the use sites in `PBW.lean`, `FiltrationGradedEquiv.lean:89,91,103,104,125` and `ExteriorFiltration.lean:94`, matching the PR's own removal of `filtrationGradedMul`, `filtrationGradedOne` and `filtrationGradedAlgebraMap₀`.
findings.issue: `FiltrationGradedPiece` (:194) and `filtrationPreviousRestricted` (:156) duplicate the new `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.GradedPiece` (AssociatedGraded.lean:107) and `previousRestricted` (:81); after this PR `PBW.lean` names the same objects both ways in one file, e.g. `associatedGraded (ι Q)` and `gradedMul (ι Q)` (PBW.lean:263, 155) alongside `FiltrationGradedPiece Q n` (PBW.lean:62, 109, 152, 220).

summary: Generalizing the Clifford associated graded to word filtrations is genuine deduplication and reuses Mathlib correctly (Mathlib has no associated-graded API: `RingTheory/FilteredAlgebra/` holds only `Basic.lean`). But the PR deletes only the Clifford graded-operation wrappers and keeps the Clifford quotient wrappers, so five declarations now restate the newly added generic ones up to reducible unfolding.
